label: Small test — XYZ-EUR vs EURUSD (1x)
description: A small, 1x preset to test XYZ-EUR/USDC:USDC vs MT5 EURUSD: 1,000 EUR per level = one 0.01-lot EURUSD hedge (about 1,100 USD); two grid levels per side, so at most 2000 units each way; isolated margin; daily loss capped at 25 USD and 15,000 USD of volume per leg. Sizes assume a broker whose minimum lot is the usual one — Save checks them against the market the bot reports; start in DRY RUN.
